outputs.L1: Provided is an image processing device comprising: a changing unit configured to change a threshold value of intensity for each point within an image; a first display control unit configured to control display of points having an intensity value equal to or greater than the threshold value each time the threshold value is changed by the changing unit; a receiving unit configured to receive designation of one or a plurality of predetermined regions within a displayed image based on a user operation; a fixing unit configured to fix the threshold value of each point within the designated predetermined region at the threshold value set by the changing unit at the time the predetermined region is designated; and a second display control unit configured, when one or a plurality of predetermined regions are present within the image, to control display of points within the predetermined region that have an intensity value equal to or greater than the threshold value fixed by the fixing unit, and points outside the predetermined region that have an intensity value equal to or greater than the threshold value changed by the changing unit.
outputs.L2: An image processing apparatus is provided. The apparatus includes: a threshold changing unit configured to vary an intensity threshold for points in an image; a first display control unit configured to display, whenever the threshold is changed, points whose intensity values are equal to or higher than the changed threshold; a receiving unit configured to accept, based on a user operation, designation of one or more predetermined regions in the displayed image; a fixing unit configured to lock, for each point in a designated predetermined region, the threshold value set by the changing unit at the moment that region is designated; and a second display control unit configured, when one or more predetermined regions exist in the image, to control display of both points inside the predetermined region whose intensity values are equal to or higher than the fixed threshold and points outside the predetermined region whose intensity values are equal to or higher than the threshold being changed by the changing unit.
outputs.L3:
The image processing device includes a changing unit configured to adjust an intensity threshold value for points within an image. The threshold value may be changed, for example, in response to a user operation or according to a predetermined processing condition.

A first display control unit displays, in the image, points having intensity values equal to or greater than the current threshold value whenever the threshold value is changed. In this way, the displayed image is updated dynamically in accordance with changes to the threshold value, allowing the user to visually confirm which points satisfy the current threshold condition.

The device further includes a receiving unit that accepts a user designation of one or more predetermined regions within the displayed image. The predetermined regions may be selected by the user from among areas displayed on the screen, such as by drawing, clicking, or otherwise specifying a region of interest.

A fixing unit is provided to fix, or lock, the threshold value for points within each designated region. Specifically, when a region is designated by the user, the fixing unit stores the threshold value being used at the time of designation and applies that fixed threshold value to points located within the designated region.

A second display control unit then controls display of the image such that points inside the designated regions are displayed based on the corresponding fixed threshold value, while points outside the designated regions are displayed based on the threshold value that continues to be dynamically changed by the changing unit. Accordingly, even if the threshold value is subsequently adjusted, the display condition within the designated regions remains based on the threshold value fixed at the time of designation, whereas the display condition outside those regions continues to change in accordance with the updated threshold value.
outputs.L4:
An image processing device is provided for interactively processing and displaying an image by applying threshold values to image intensity information. The device is configured to receive image data, such as grayscale image data, medical image data, or other intensity-based image data, and to display, on a display screen, image points or pixels that satisfy a selected threshold condition. The threshold condition may include, for example, an upper threshold, a lower threshold, or a range between two threshold values. By changing the threshold value or values, a user can cause different portions of the image to appear or disappear, thereby enabling visual extraction of structures, objects, or regions having particular intensity characteristics.

The device includes an input unit that allows the user to adjust the threshold values while observing the displayed image. As the threshold values are changed, the image processing device updates the displayed image in real time or near real time so that only the pixels, points, or image components meeting the current threshold condition are displayed or emphasized. This interactive thresholding operation allows the user to search for an appropriate threshold setting while visually confirming the effect of the adjustment on the image.

The device further includes a region designation function. Using a pointing device, touch panel, cursor, stylus, or other input means, the user may designate one or more regions within the displayed image. A designated region may be defined by drawing a closed boundary, selecting a rectangular or polygonal area, selecting a region grown from a seed point, or using any other suitable region selection method. The designated region may correspond to an anatomical structure, a defect, an object of interest, or any other area that the user wishes to preserve under a particular threshold condition.

When a region is designated, the threshold value or threshold range currently applied to that region is fixed for the designated region. In other words, the image processing device stores the threshold condition associated with the designated region at the time of designation and continues to apply that stored threshold condition to image points inside the region. As a result, the visual representation of the selected region remains stable, even if the user subsequently changes the threshold values for the rest of the image.

At the same time, the threshold values applied to portions of the image outside the designated region remain adjustable. The user may therefore continue to change the threshold values for the non-designated region while the designated region is maintained under its fixed threshold condition. This makes it possible to compare a stable, region-specific visualization with changing threshold displays in surrounding or remaining image areas. The user can thus preserve an area of interest once an appropriate threshold has been found, while continuing to explore and adjust the threshold settings for other parts of the image.

The device may allow multiple regions to be designated. Each designated region may have its own fixed threshold value or threshold range, corresponding to the threshold condition in effect when that region was selected. Accordingly, different regions in the same image may be displayed according to different threshold conditions. The thresholds for regions not yet designated may remain under global control, while the thresholds for previously designated regions remain locked unless the user deliberately releases or modifies them.

The image processing device may also provide controls for canceling a designated region, changing the fixed threshold assigned to a designated region, adding new regions, merging regions, or returning all regions to a common threshold setting. The display may visually distinguish fixed-threshold regions from adjustable regions by using different colors, outlines, shading, transparency, or other display attributes. This enables the user to recognize which parts of the image are locked to previously selected threshold values and which parts remain responsive to current threshold adjustment.

By fixing the threshold condition for a designated region while permitting continued adjustment outside that region, the device improves interactive image analysis. It prevents an already optimized region from being lost or altered during subsequent threshold operations, and it allows the user to examine other image portions without disturbing the visual state of the selected region. This is particularly useful in applications where different areas of an image have different intensity distributions or where a single global threshold is insufficient to display all desired structures clearly.

Thus, the described image processing device supports both global threshold adjustment and region-specific threshold fixation. It enables a user to interactively determine suitable threshold values, designate regions of interest, preserve the display of those regions under their selected threshold conditions, and continue adjusting threshold values elsewhere in the image. This provides stable and flexible visualization of complex image data while maintaining intuitive user control.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a patent-style "Provided is..." summary for an image processing device that lets a user change intensity thresholds, select regions, and freeze thresholds inside selected regions while continuing to adjust thresholds outside them.
counterfactuals.output: Provided is an image processing device including: a display unit configured to display an image; an operation unit configured to receive a threshold-changing operation by a user; a region selection unit configured to receive selection of at least one region in the displayed image; and a control unit configured to process the image based on an intensity threshold. The control unit changes the intensity threshold in accordance with the threshold-changing operation and updates display of the image based on the changed intensity threshold. When the at least one region is selected, the control unit stores, for the selected region, the intensity threshold applied at a time of selection or at a time of a freeze instruction, and thereafter maintains the stored intensity threshold for pixels or image data within the selected region while permitting the intensity threshold for image data outside the selected region to be further changed in accordance with subsequent threshold-changing operations. Thus, threshold conditions inside a user-selected region can be fixed while threshold adjustment is continued for other portions of the image.
